mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank policy support, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals manufacturing contraction that precedes economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating non-farm payroll growth indicates strengthening labor market conditions that immediately boost consumer spending and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth accelerates, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,000,000 annual units signal robust residential construction activity that drives economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1000.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation combined with stable interest rates signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The CPIAUCSL-FEDFUNDS interaction fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth indicates strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth accelerates, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
